sprint3.flashOfInsight: bounded and corrected (2026-09-25): once per summoning, swift action, an arming with no duration of its own that the next attack ends; that attack's own d20 is chosen as a natural 20 through the game's pre-rolled-result seam; the hit and the threat follow from the roll, the critical confirmation is rolled normally, no automatic-hit flag is set, no other roll is touched, and the persistence trio proves the single armed use across the save and the reload
sprint3.cyclopsArmorClass: 19: +4 hide armor as an armor-descriptor fact (no item, loot or inventory), -1 Dexterity, +7 natural armor, -1 size; live breakdown in the correction rules scenario
sprint3.docileHooves: Pony and Horse hooves are secondary through the game's own secondary flag set by a docile-hoof carrier on both hoof entities (-5 to hit, half Strength to damage, both in the full attack); corrected 2026-09-25

sprint4.grappleLifecycle: shared and corrected (2026-09-25): grab by limb identity against a foe of the holder's size or smaller through the game's grapple check with +4; native hold parts (single link) or held-state buffs naming the holder (multi-link) carry the project buffs; maintain each round at +5 more dealing the establishing limb's own weapon damage (mound adds constrict 2d6+7) or release; a swallower that began the round holding uses a successful check as though pinning and swallows a foe up to one size smaller (the worm) or engulfs Medium or smaller (the flytrap); the hold's end releases its own target(s); the swallow lifecycle spits out on traits end; party members held or swallowed by a KMG summon are released on area leave and repaired on area load
sprint4.giantFlytrap: one grab link per bite, four at most, each held state naming the flytrap and its establishing bite; a bite that holds cannot take a second foe; engulf of a Medium or smaller foe held since the round began (project Engulfed state, 1d8+7 bludgeoning plus 1d8 acid per round); release on escape, the last link's end, disposal, the swallow lifecycle and the area-leave sweep; the pathfinder still routes a free unit past four held units

sprint5.donors: nearest native summoned mephit body: air (dust, salt), water (ice, ooze, steam), fire (magma); no Lightning Mephit
sprint5.breath: the donor's 15-foot cone rebuilt with the tabletop energy and dice (dust/salt slashing 1d4, ice cold 1d4, magma fire 1d8, ooze acid 1d4, steam fire 1d4), an enemies-only effect, and the sickening rider on a failed Reflex save (ooze: Reflex negates both); Constitution-based DC as the native breaths
sprint5.spellLikeAbilities: one use per summoning each: dust blur and project wind wall (15-foot shelter for 6 rounds for every creature inside that is not the mephit's enemy: arrows and bolts miss, other ranged weapons 30% miss chance); ice magic missile and project chill metal (close range, a metal-bearing foe only, Will negates, the seven-round cold table in full for metal armor and minimal for a metal weapon); magma project pyrotechnics (enemies within 20 feet blinded 1d4+1 rounds, Will negates) and project magma form (5 rounds: DR 20/magic, speed 10, no attacks, abilities intact); ooze acid arrow and stinking cloud on a project ally-safe clone of the native cloud area (enemies of the caster only); salt glitterdust (enemies only) and dehydrate (project 20-foot enemies-only burst 2d8, Fortitude half); steam blur and boiling rain (project 20-foot enemies-only burst 2d6 fire, Fortitude half); every project DC Charisma-based at caster level 6 (corrected 2026-09-25)
sprint5.visuals: a private clone of the shared rig's materials per view carrying the variant's rim light colour (the HDR glow through which the translucent mephit body is seen: sand, icy cyan-white, ember red, slime green, crystalline white, grey-white vapour), applied on view attach, handed to the game's material controller and never written to the donor's shared material; no emission glow (the shader has no emission slot); a tint cannot show on the mephit rig because the controller rewrites its tint slot
sprint5.icons: Blender 4.5 procedural renders from one parametrized mephit builder in six elemental dressings
sprint5.visualResourceOwnership: every material clone, coat texture and material-controller instance is owned per view (SummonVisualOwnership) and destroyed with the view (UnitEntityView.OnDestroy prefix), on a failed or incomplete attach (same-frame rollback) and on the module-wide sweep; the visual lifecycle scenario counts the variant-prefixed objects back to baseline after each cycle (corrected 2026-09-25)

sprint6.grabCarriers: Monitor Lizard bite, Grizzly Bear claws, Dire Bear claws on the shared summon grapple lifecycle (SummonGrabComponent carriers); the mound-specific native grab graph stays unused
sprint6.giantSpider: native 60-foot blindsight for tremorsense; native web immunity; bounded ranged Web corrected 2026-09-25: a 50-foot ranged touch attack through the game's projectile delivery with its ray weapon, one foe up to one size larger, no saving throw, the native web-grappled state for at most ten rounds with its own Constitution-based per-round break-free (DC 10 + half hit dice + Constitution), two uses per summoning, its own brain; climb omitted (no save-safe seam)
sprint6.pixie: verified, not changed: sixteen sleep arrows and one irresistible dance per summoning on named resources, one cast action, live mechanical evidence each run

sprint7.grab: grab by limb and target identity on the shared summon grapple lifecycle (SummonGrabComponent): the leopard, lion and dire lion with the bite only, the smilodon with the bite and both foreclaws; a rake slot never grabs; a foe of the cat's size or smaller (corrected 2026-09-25)
